dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Surely it isn't as simple as that...

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Hmph. Sharp people always make enemies of others.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Some people were born in the sun, and thus take light and warmth for granted.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: But love, piety, holiness... all these wonderful things were built on the blood and tears of sinners.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Can you all not see it, or do you just look away?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then don't ask or think about it too much. When sin comes knocking, judgment will soon follow.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Take what I've said as a warning. Take this with you, too. I hope it will keep you vigilant.
